en: I am busy, you are not busy.
zh: 我很忙，你不忙。

en: Are you cold? No, I'm not cold. I'm hot.
zh: 你冷吗？不，我不冷，我很热。

en: Is he busy? Yes, he is. He is tired.
zh: 他忙吗？是的，他很忙，他很累。

en: Am I late? No, you are not. You are early.
zh: 我迟到了吗？没有，你没有迟到，你来得很早。

en: Are they good? No, they are bad.
zh: 他们好吗？不，他们很坏。

en: We are very busy, but my boss is not busy.
zh: 我们很忙，但我的老板不忙。

en: You are my good friend. But he is not my friend.
zh: 你是我的好朋友，但他不是我的朋友。

en: I am in my room. You are in English school.
zh: 我在我的房间里，你在英语学校。

en: Where are you? I'm here!
zh: 你在哪里？我在这里！

en: Where are they? They are in America now.
zh: 他们在哪里？他们现在在美国。

en: Where is my laptop? It's in your bag. Here!
zh: 我的笔记本电脑在哪里？在你的包里，给！

en: What is it? It's a book.
zh: 这是什么？这是一本书。

en: Who is she? She is my sister.
zh: 她是谁？她是我姐姐。

en: This is a good company. That is a bad company.
zh: 这是一家好公司，那是一家不好的公司。

en: This is my chair. That is your chair.
zh: 这是我的椅子，那是你的椅子。

en: Where is his phone? His phone is there.
zh: 他的手机在哪里？他的手机在那里。

en: Our boss is very busy every day.
zh: 我们的老板每天都很忙。

en: Is he our new colleague? No, he is not. He is our new boss.
zh: 他是我们的新同事吗？不，他不是，他是我们的新老板。

en: What color is your pen? It's blue and black.
zh: 你的笔是什么颜色？是蓝色和黑色的。

en: What is your favorite color? My favorite color is pink.
zh: 你最喜欢的颜色是什么？我最喜欢粉色。

en: Our house is not big. It's very small.
zh: 我们的房子不大，很小。

en: I have a very tall friend. His name is Mark.
zh: 我有一个很高的朋友，他叫Mark。

en: Is English difficult? Not really. I think it's easy.
zh: 英语难吗？不太难，我觉得很简单。

en: Do you live in an apartment or a house? I live in a house.
zh: 你住公寓还是房子？我住房子。

en: They don't drink beer and coffee. They only drink water and tea.
zh: 他们不喝啤酒和咖啡，他们只喝水和茶。

en: Why do you like fast food? Because fast food is cheap and good.
zh: 你为什么喜欢快餐？因为快餐便宜又好吃。

en: Where do you go tomorrow? Tomorrow I go to France.
zh: 你明天去哪里？我明天去法国。

en: Do you know his email or phone number? Sorry, I don't know.
zh: 你知道他的邮箱或电话号码吗？抱歉，我不知道。

en: Who do you like? I like my colleague. She's so beautiful and smart!
zh: 你喜欢谁？我喜欢我的同事，她又漂亮又聪明！

en: Do you live near here? No, I live in the center.
zh: 你住在这附近吗？不，我住在市中心。

en: Do you have children? Yes, I do. I have two boys.
zh: 你有孩子吗？有的，我有两个儿子。

en: My best friend's name is Antonia. She's very beautiful and really funny.
zh: 我最好的朋友叫Antonia，她很漂亮也很有趣。

en: She has a brother and a sister. Their names are Mark and Alison.
zh: 她有一个哥哥和一个姐姐，他们叫Mark和Alison。

en: Where do you live? What do you have for breakfast?
zh: 你住在哪里？你早餐吃什么？

en: I get up at 7:30 am every day.
zh: 我每天早上七点半起床。

en: I usually have a shower in the morning, but sometimes in the evening.
zh: 我通常早上洗澡，但有时候晚上洗澡。

en: I never have breakfast. I'm not hungry in the morning.
zh: 我从不吃早餐，我早上不饿。

en: I start my work at 8 am, and finish at 5:30 pm.
zh: 我早上八点开始工作，下午五点半下班。

en: I often go to the gym in the evening. And then I go home.
zh: 我经常晚上去健身房，然后回家。

en: How often do you do housework? I never do my housework.
zh: 你多久做一次家务？我从不做家务。

en: I always drink a lot of water, because water is good for people.
zh: 我总是喝很多水，因为水对人有好处。

en: What time do we study next time? Our next class is on Friday.
zh: 我们下次什么时候上课？我们下节课是星期五。

en: I can drive a car, but my sister can't drive.
zh: 我会开车，但我姐姐不会开车。

en: Can you give me a pen, please? Thank you!
zh: 能给我一支笔吗？谢谢！

en: Excuse me, can I sit here? Yes, sure!
zh: 不好意思，我能坐这里吗？当然可以！

en: Can we go to the cinema tonight? No, I'm sorry, I can't.
zh: 我们今晚能去电影院吗？不好意思，不能。

en: I'm sorry teacher, I can't read this word. Can you help me?
zh: 老师对不起，我不会读这个单词，你能帮我吗？

en: Where can I change my money? I don't know, maybe in Greenbelt.
zh: 我在哪里能换钱？我不知道，也许在Greenbelt。

en: You can't park in the shopping center! It's really expensive.
zh: 你不能在购物中心停车！非常贵。

en: Does she read books? Yes, she does.
zh: 她读书吗？是的，她读。

en: Where does your father work? He works in a hospital.
zh: 你爸爸在哪里工作？他在医院工作。

en: What does your husband do? He teaches Japanese in school.
zh: 你丈夫是做什么的？他在学校教日语。

en: My friend lives alone, because he likes quiet.
zh: 我朋友一个人住，因为他喜欢安静。

en: Does his father like his job? No, he thinks his job is very boring.
zh: 他爸爸喜欢他的工作吗？不，他觉得工作很无聊。

en: What time does the class start? The class starts at 10:30 am.
zh: 课几点开始？课十点半开始。

en: I usually get up at about 9:30, and I have a shower.
zh: 我通常九点半左右起床，然后洗澡。

en: I never have breakfast. I make a fire and clean the house.
zh: 我从不吃早餐，我生火然后打扫房子。

en: In the evening I usually go out with friends.
zh: 晚上我通常和朋友出去。

en: How much money does your boyfriend earn? It's a secret.
zh: 你男朋友挣多少钱？这是秘密。

en: How do you relax at the weekend? I often go outside to meet my friends.
zh: 你周末怎么放松？我经常出去见朋友。

en: Do you like your job? Yes, I like it very much.
zh: 你喜欢你的工作吗？是的，我非常喜欢。

en: Do you prefer the summer or the winter? I prefer the summer.
zh: 你更喜欢夏天还是冬天？我更喜欢夏天。

en: She was a teacher before, but now she is an artist.
zh: 她以前是老师，但现在是艺术家。

en: I was very busy last night. Where were you?
zh: 我昨晚很忙，你昨晚在哪里？

en: My boss wasn't in the office yesterday.
zh: 我老板昨天不在办公室。

en: I'm sorry, it was my mistake. I was wrong, and you were right.
zh: 对不起，是我的错，我错了，你是对的。

en: When was your birthday? My birthday was last week.
zh: 你的生日是什么时候？我的生日是上周。

en: Where were you last month? I was on holiday with my parents.
zh: 你上个月在哪里？我和父母一起度假。

en: I like driving my car in the evening. It's so dark and quiet.
zh: 我喜欢晚上开车，很暗也很安静。

en: I hate going to parties. I love being at home.
zh: 我讨厌参加派对，我喜欢待在家里。

en: What do you do in your free time? I like reading books.
zh: 你空闲时间做什么？我喜欢看书。

en: Do you prefer dancing or singing? I like both!
zh: 你更喜欢跳舞还是唱歌？我都喜欢！

en: Yesterday I got up early. And then I had breakfast in bed.
zh: 昨天我起得很早，然后在床上吃了早餐。

en: She didn't go to work yesterday, because she was very sick.
zh: 她昨天没去上班，因为她病得很重。

en: Did you go to Greece last year? No, I didn't. I went to Mexico.
zh: 你去年去希腊了吗？没有，我去了墨西哥。

en: Where did you go last night? I went to a bar.
zh: 你昨晚去哪里了？我去了酒吧。

en: I lived in Brazil in 1993. Then I lived in Poland.
zh: 我1993年住在巴西，后来住在波兰。

en: Did you finish your homework? Sorry, teacher, I was so busy yesterday!
zh: 你做完作业了吗？老师对不起，我昨天太忙了！

en: What time did you start and finish your work yesterday?
zh: 你昨天几点开始工作，几点下班？

en: When did you arrive in Manila?
zh: 你什么时候到马尼拉的？

en: Did you go to school when you were a child?
zh: 你小时候上学吗？

en: Last April two teenagers wanted to go to Australia for their vacation.
zh: 去年四月两个青少年想去澳大利亚度假。

en: They checked in and waited for the plane to leave.
zh: 他们办理了登机手续，等飞机起飞。

en: I thought she was a nice person! But actually she's very annoying.
zh: 我以为她是个好人！但其实她很烦人。

en: What did you buy at the supermarket? I bought fish and shrimps.
zh: 你在超市买了什么？我买了鱼和虾。

en: Did you find a new job? No, I didn't. It's very hard now.
zh: 你找到新工作了吗？没有，现在很难找。

en: Why do you look so sad? I lost my keys yesterday morning.
zh: 你为什么看起来很难过？我昨天早上丢了钥匙。

en: I stayed the first night at a hotel.
zh: 第一晚我住在酒店。

en: I spoke a little Italian from school, but I couldn't understand people.
zh: 我在学校学过一点意大利语，但我听不懂别人说话。

en: Rome changed my life. I met new people from all over the world.
zh: 罗马改变了我的生活，我遇见了来自世界各地的新朋友。

en: Mr Travers died between midnight last night and seven o'clock this morning.
zh: 特拉弗斯先生在昨晚午夜到今早七点之间去世了。

en: Did you hear anything when you were in your room? Yes, I heard the door open.
zh: 你在房间里时听到什么了吗？是的，我听到门开了。

en: Hello, sir! There is a problem with my bicycle. Can you help me?
zh: 你好先生！我的自行车有问题，你能帮我吗？

en: Is there a good restaurant near your office? Let's go there tonight!
zh: 你办公室附近有好餐厅吗？我们今晚去那里吧！

en: Are there any eggs in our fridge? I want to make some breakfast.
zh: 我们冰箱里有鸡蛋吗？我想做早餐。

en: There are some interesting books in the library.
zh: 图书馆里有一些有趣的书。

en: There isn't enough sugar in my coffee.
zh: 我咖啡里的糖不够。

en: Your room's upstairs, number seven. Is there a lift? No, I'm sorry, there isn't.
zh: 你的房间在楼上，七号。有电梯吗？很抱歉，没有。

en: There are two beds. We wanted a double bed.
zh: 这里有两张单人床，我们想要一张双人床。

en: There isn't a bath! No, there's a shower. It uses less water.
zh: 没有浴缸！不，有淋浴，更省水。

en: How many bathrooms are there? There's one downstairs, and three upstairs.
zh: 有几个浴室？楼下一个，楼上三个。

en: Is there a television? No, there isn't, sir. But there's a piano.
zh: 有电视吗？先生，没有，但是有一台钢琴。

en: Don't worry, madam. There is central heating in the house.
zh: 别担心，女士，这房子里有中央供暖。

en: I saw her on the platform. A tall, blonde woman with dark blue eyes.
zh: 我在站台上看见了她，一个高高的、深蓝色眼睛的金发女人。

en: Excuse me, can I sit here? Sure, I said. She sat down next to me.
zh: 不好意思，我能坐这里吗？当然，我说。她就坐在了我旁边。

en: What do you do? I work in property. Flats and houses.
zh: 你是做什么的？我从事房地产工作，公寓和房子。

en: I have a flat near the river.
zh: 我有一套靠近河边的公寓。

en: Her car was in the station car park. She drove fast, very fast.
zh: 她的车停在车站停车场，她开得很快，非常快。

en: I opened the door of my flat and turned on the light.
zh: 我打开了公寓的门，打开了灯。
